1.w: A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah, for the one directing. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O YHWH, God of my salvation, [by] day I have cried out, [and] in the night before You.

2.w: May my prayer come before Your face; incline Your ear to my cry!

3.w: For my soul is filled with troubles, and my life has reached to Sheol.

4.w: I am counted with those going down into the Pit; I am like a man with no strength,

5.w: among the dead [set] free, like the slain lying down in the grave, whom You do not remember anymore, even they [who] are cut off from Your hand.

6.w: You have set me in the lowest Pit, in darkness in the depths.

7.w: Upon me Your wrath has grabbed hold, and [with] all Your waves You have afflicted. Selah

8.w: You have put my acquaintances far from me; You have made me loathsome to them; [I am] shut in, and I cannot go forth.

9.w: My eye languishes from [this] affliction; I have called to You, O YHWH, all the day; I have stretched out to You my hands.

10.w: Will You work wonders for the dead? And if departed spirits rise up, do they thank You? Selah

11.w: Can Your loving devotion be recounted in the Grave, [or] Your faithfulness in Abaddon?

12.w: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, and Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

13.w: And I, O YHWH, cry for help to You, and in the morning my prayer comes before You.

14.w: Why, O YHWH, do You reject my soul? You hide Your face from me.

15.w: I [am] afflicted and dying from my youth; I bear Your terrors; I am in despair.

16.w: Your wrath has passed over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.

17.w: They came around me like the waters all the day, they surrounded me altogether.

18.w: You have put far my beloved and friend; my close acquaintance [is] darkness.
